removed_rules: No automatic longshot stake penalty based only on price

admission_rule: Shadow variants inherit the canonical candidate set and Kelly>=0.05 gate; they change sizing only unless a future preregistered test explicitly changes admission.

shadow_bankroll_tracking.initialization_at_j4: Each FK15/FK20/FK25 track starts J4 at the same MXN 523.0512159211471 opening bankroll as canonical V2.1.
shadow_bankroll_tracking.prospective_rule_from_j5: Each shadow variant compounds independently. Its closing bankroll from the previous jornada becomes its own next opening bankroll; it is never reset to the canonical bankroll.
shadow_bankroll_tracking.reason: Independent compounding is required to compare realized log growth, drawdown and risk of ruin honestly.

shadow_portfolio_rules.stake_precision: retain unrounded decimal MXN internally for research; display may round to 2 decimals
shadow_portfolio_rules.secondary_parlay: same canonical qualifying 2-leg parlay, fixed 5 MXN, so staking comparison changes singles only
shadow_portfolio_rules.ceiling_method: reserve any canonical 5 MXN parlay stake first; if calculated shadow single stakes exceed remaining risk capacity, scale all shadow single stakes pro-rata to fit the remaining capacity

tail_uncertainty_discount.reason: Insufficient evidence that calibration error is concentrated in probability tails. Must be demonstrated before use.

promotion_rule.preferred_evidence_horizon: approximately 40-50 jornadas or an equivalently credible sample of qualifying bets

notes: Probability, nominal odds and favorite/underdog labels never determine stake in isolation.
No bucket is required to receive capital in any jornada.
The objective is to test whether dynamic fractional Kelly reduces drawdown/volatility without unacceptable loss of bankroll growth.
The parlay is held constant across canonical and shadow portfolios so that the shadow comparison isolates the effect of single-bet sizing.
The independent-compounding rule was clarified after J4 settlement and is prospective from J5; it does not change any J4 stake or result.
